Classic DCA buys the same fixed amount at every scheduled interval, regardless of market conditions. This is the simplest and most straightforward approach to dollar-cost averaging.
This strategy adjusts your purchase amount based on how far the current price is from the All-Time High. Buy less when price is near ATH, buy more during dips.
Example: With a base amount of 100 EUR, if BTC is 50% below ATH, you\'ll buy 150 EUR worth.
This strategy uses the Fear & Greed Index to adjust purchases. Buy more when the market is fearful (often a good opportunity), buy less during extreme greed.
Example: With a base amount of 100 EUR, during Extreme Fear you\'ll buy 250 EUR worth.

AccBot uses 4 notification channels. In Android settings, you can customize each channel individually:

• DCA Service — background service status
• Purchase Notifications — successful trades
• Error Notifications — failed trades
• Low Balance Warnings — balance alerts

For each channel, you can set custom sound, vibration, and Do Not Disturb exceptions.
